item.title: Trump dodged Yemen's plea for military support amid Houthi attacks on Riyadh: Report
item.description: President Trump did not commit US forces to aid Yemen against the Houthis. Yemeni President Alimi sought American backing for his government's efforts. US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman, discussing a ceasefire. Trump reportedly called off planned airstrikes against Houthi targets. The conflict has caused significant casualties and displacement within Yemen.

item.title: Ishan is the 'chosen one'? Mayawati's latest U-turn deepens ongoing BSP family drama
item.description: In a strategic move, Mayawati has selected Ishan Anand for an important party role, succeeding his brother Akash Anand who was recently ousted. Akash's conduct and the potential influence of his father-in-law were cited as reasons for this decision. Mayawati highlights the necessity of integrity and commitment for Ishan as he embarks on this new chapter in the BSP.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
item.description: USCIS warns applicants about businesses falsely promising faster visa and Green Card processing. These entities claim special government connections and demand fees for expedited services. Applicants should use official .gov resources and report suspicious offers to avoid unauthorized providers. The Department of Justice offers lists of low-cost or free legal immigration services. USCIS also provides tips for accurately completing and submitting application forms online.

item.title: Why parents keep old report cards and childhood drawings, according to psychology
item.description: For parents, childhood drawings and school assignments go beyond mere artifacts of nostalgia; they encapsulate rich autobiographical memories and poignant family moments. Studies reveal that nostalgic feelings can elevate the perceived value of these everyday objects. Furthermore, these keepsakes serve as visual reminders of the swift journey through parenthood, capturing the essence of time spent in care and love.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Oilers linked to Dylan Larkin trade in Matthew Savoie-led blockbuster
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers are speculated to be considering a trade that would bring Detroit Red Wings center Dylan Larkin into their lineup. Reports suggest a trade package featuring Matthew Savoie along with other young prospects. However, Larkin’s contract complications and his no-trade clause could hinder any discussions. With Detroit's focus on a non-rebuilding strategy, this remains more of a theoretical scenario than a likely transaction.

item.title: Washington couple spent $50m on Lake Washington retreat; now asks $71m
item.description: Dwayne and Terese Clark are selling their Lake Washington estate for seventy-one million dollars. This waterfront compound features two Mediterranean-style residences on two point three acres. The property includes a main house and a separate wellness retreat with pools. They are relocating to Arizona after investing fifty million dollars into the homes. The sale could set a new record for Pacific Northwest residential real estate.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
item.description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Michael Dell’s $10.9m Boston penthouse heads to auction with $6.5m reserve
item.description: Michael Dell's luxurious penthouse in Boston is hitting the auction block with a starting bid of $6.5 million. Initially acquired for $10.9 million a decade ago, this stunning property is situated on the 59th floor of the renowned Millennium Tower. Following several attempts at traditional sale routes, Dell has opted for an auction format that wraps up in late October, making it a must-watch event for high-end real estate enthusiasts.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Pak in crisis: PTI to hold Sept 27 stir 'at all costs' for release of Imran Khan
item.description: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf plans a protest on September 27 for Imran Khan's release. Legal challenges have been filed against the detention of his three sisters. The party insists the demonstrations will proceed despite arrests of its leaders. Authorities state the protest will not be allowed to disrupt the capital city. Imran Khan's son condemned the detentions and called for international intervention.

Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.

item.title: Manoj Bajpayee moves Delhi High Court to protect personality rights from AI misuse
item.description: In a notable legal move, actor Manoj Bajpayee has turned to the Delhi High Court to safeguard his identity. He claims his image and voice have been used without permission, particularly through AI technologies. The court raised issues regarding jurisdiction; however, Bajpayee's legal team referenced defendants based in Delhi. This petition mirrors the growing trend of public figures seeking similar protections due to concerns over unauthorized endorsements and AI-generated content.

item.title: The 'rebel' hit by rebellion: How Mamata's TMC journey has come full circle
item.description: Nearly three decades after Mamata Banerjee broke away from the Congress to build the Trinamool Congress, she finds herself in a very different battle: fighting a rebellion within her own party, a dispute over its name and symbol, and a stronger BJP in Bengal has pushed back to the 'sister party'.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA MUKHERJEE

item.title: Monty Python star says he wants to be buried in Provence after surviving cancer
item.description: Monty Python star Eric Idle, 83, has opened up about surviving pancreatic cancer, his peaceful life in Provence and his views on mortality. Idle also recalled a 2001 conversation with Beatles legend George Harrison about death and rebirth, revealing their differing beliefs about the afterlife during Harrison’s final days and his iconic comedy legacy.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: UK to introduce special rape and serious sexual offence courts, amid low prosecution rate
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced dedicated courts for sexual offence cases. These new courts aim to expedite convictions and reduce case backlogs significantly. Specialized training will be provided to court personnel for handling sensitive cases. Victims will receive a dedicated point of contact throughout the legal process. This initiative supports the government's commitment to reducing violence against women.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: ‘Resolve issues through dialogue’: Govt urges bank employees to call off Sept 28-30 stir
item.description: The finance ministry urged bank employees to resolve demands through dialogue. A three-day nationwide strike is planned from September 28 to 30. Unions seek a five-day banking week and withdrawal of the PLI scheme. The government has addressed most concerns and is examining remaining issues. Banks are preparing for potential disruptions and advising customers to use digital services.

item.title: Chess Olympiad forfeit row: Israel blasts FIDE for not honouring 'commitments'
item.description: Israel Chess Federation chief Zvika Barkai has accused FIDE of failing to honour a prior agreement over scheduling Israel’s Chess Olympiad matches around Yom Kippur. Both Israeli teams forfeited their Round 6 games after the Netherlands and Bulgaria declined schedule changes. Barkai praised Singapore and Colombia for accommodating Israel, criticised FIDE’s handling, and warned the forfeits could significantly affect Israel’s rankings.

item.title: Flight fare analysis: How to get cheaper tickets by booking in advance - decoded
item.description: A ticket bought the day before departure costs about 25% more than the same journey booked 30 days ahead. On all 54 metro routes tracked, not one is cheaper to book late. The penalty runs from 3% on Bengaluru to Chennai to 121% on Ahmedabad to Pune. Thirty days out is the floor. Booking two or three months ahead is slightly dearer than booking one.

item.title: Delhi jail shocker: Undertrial stabbed in neck by 2 inmates inside Rohini prison
item.description: An undertrial inmate was fatally stabbed by two fellow prisoners inside Delhi's Rohini Central Jail. The deceased, Pradeep alias Mohinder, sustained a neck injury from a sharp weapon. He was returning to his barrack when the alleged attack occurred on Monday. Hospital officials declared him brought dead after his swift transfer for treatment. Police are registering a case and examining CCTV footage of the incident.
